# StatusBadge

Each status has its own shape as well as its own colour: success = circle (status-success), warning = triangle (status-warning), error = diamond (status-error)…

`PhantomPortals.StatusBadge` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<PhantomPortals.StatusBadge>…</PhantomPortals.StatusBadge>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="PhantomPortals.StatusBadge">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Status by shape + word + colour: circle ok, triangle warn, diamond error, ring running, square idle.
